parameters.text: 같이 들어볼까요? 좋아요, 이번에는 조금 다르게 해볼게요. 작은 차이가 모이면, 우리만의 목소리가 돼요.
parameters.voice_description: Native Korean female voice, young adult. A sunny, refreshing, clear voice with rich resonance and relaxed confidence. She speaks with a smile you can hear, energetic but comfortable, like a warm lively conversation. Crisp Korean consonants, rounded vowels, playful tiny rises and falls, and a light smile continuing through the last word. Dry close studio sound.
